_comment: SITE-013: Initial route performance budgets. Thresholds are advisory until G2 gate. Values represent gzipped sizes in bytes.

_baseline._note: Measured from the initial shell build (SITE-004 complete). These are the actual values at baseline capture time.

content._comment: Static content pages: homepage, guides, articles, legal. Minimal or no JS expected. Budget set at ~5x current baseline to allow growth through M2.

catalog._comment: Primitive/component/block/template documentation pages. May have interactive examples. Budget allows for live demos and code blocks.

tool._comment: Playground and theme-builder routes. Heavy client-side tools with larger JS budgets. Isolated via SITE-012 import boundaries.

global._comment: Cross-route global limits. maxTotalJsGzipSize counts each unique asset once regardless of how many routes reference it.
